topic: Tell and write the time to the nearest 5 mins on an analogue clock
rationaleNote: Three cards earned: a worked example for the harder 'to' procedure (the new skill this lesson introduces, and the one children are most likely to need to glance back at mid-task), a combined sticky-knowledge card for the two durable rules children must carry away (count in 5s; past side vs to side), and a misconception card for the canonical wrong-hour error at 'to' times. The simpler 'past' procedure was not given its own card, children have a Y2/Y3 foundation for past times and the worked-example card's Step 1 (check which side) directs them to the correct procedure. No photos available in photo-requirements.json.
note: Content shortened from the source fixture so it fits A3; the source overflows the builder's own validation even at A4.

items.label: Step 1
items.text: Check the minute hand: past side or to side?

items.label: Step 2
items.text: Count back in 5s from 12 to the minute hand.

items.label: Step 3
items.text: Check the hour hand: which hour is it nearly at?
The minute hand counts in 5s round the clock. Each number means 5 more minutes.
Past side (right) = minutes past the hour. To side (left) = minutes to the next hour.
